PFT_merged.nameLong: BADM PFT of the site from pft_path, filled with the MODIS IGBP class of the grid cell holding the site where the csv has none
PFT_merged.description: IGBP number, 1 ENF, 2 EBF, 3 DNF, 4 DBF, 5 MF, 6 CSH, 7 OSH, 8 WSA, 9 SAV, 10 GRA, 11 WET, 12 CRO, 13 URB, 14 CVM, 15 SNO, 16 BSV, 17 WAT. The PFT of the site in pft_path on every time step. Sites missing from the csv or with a PFT that is not an IGBP class, such as TBD, take the MODIS IGBP class of the grid cell holding the site of each year as its BADM PFT, with the nearest year for years without one.
